claim: The rs1421085 T>C substitution disrupts a conserved ARID5B repressor motif in the adipocyte-progenitor regulatory context.
intervention: Endogenous CRISPR-Cas9 editing of rs1421085 in both risk and non-risk backgrounds; ARID5B perturbation.
alternative_explanations: Another regulatory factor could contribute to the allele-dependent enhancer effect in addition to ARID5B.
falsification_test: Show that allele-dependent IRX3/IRX5 regulation persists after ARID5B dependence is removed in the same adipocyte-progenitor context.

from: ARID5B repression loss at rs1421085 element
claim: Loss of ARID5B-mediated repression at the rs1421085 regulatory element increases IRX3 and IRX5 expression in adipocyte progenitors.
intervention: ARID5B knockdown and bidirectional rs1421085 editing.
falsification_test: Demonstrate that restoring ARID5B repression at the endogenous locus fails to reduce IRX3/IRX5 expression under matched conditions.

claim: Elevated IRX3/IRX5 shifts adipocyte differentiation away from the thermogenic beige program and decreases mitochondrial thermogenesis.
intervention: IRX3/IRX5 knockdown or overexpression; rs1421085 allele repair.
outcome_measure: Thermogenic gene program and oxygen-consumption/thermogenesis phenotypes.
alternative_explanations: Additional downstream mediators may contribute to the thermogenic phenotype.
falsification_test: Show that selective normalization of IRX3/IRX5 fails to restore thermogenic function in risk-allele adipocytes under matched conditions.

to: Irx3 expression increase in posterior hypothalamus
claim: The obesity-associated rs1421085 allele is linked to increased Irx3 expression in the mouse posterior hypothalamus, but the intervening regulatory mechanism is unresolved.
intervention: Genetically engineered mice harboring the obesity-associated rs1421085 allele.
alternative_explanations: ARID5B-dependent regulation analogous to adipocyte progenitors.
A different transcription-factor mechanism in posterior-hypothalamic cells.
Allele-dependent chromatin accessibility or 3D contact change.
An indirect mediator upstream of Irx3.
A genotype-dependent change in cell composition rather than per-cell Irx3 transcription.
falsification_test: Resolve the effect at cell-type level and show that the engineered allele does not change Irx3 expression per relevant posterior-hypothalamic cell under the conditions where the bulk/regional signal was observed.
notes: GAP-001: this is the first unresolved load-bearing edge targeted by CAUSAL-DNA.

from: IRX3 increase in IRX3-positive posterior-hypothalamic neurons
claim: Increasing IRX3 in IRX3-positive posterior-hypothalamic neurons decreases their excitability/activity.
intervention: Targeted increase of IRX3 in posterior hypothalamus / IRX3-positive neurons.
alternative_explanations: Some physiological effects of IRX3 may be mediated by additional neuronal properties beyond excitability.
falsification_test: Show that matched IRX3 elevation does not reduce excitability/activity in the implicated posterior-hypothalamic neuronal population.

to: food intake and body weight increase
claim: Inhibition of IRX3-positive posterior-hypothalamic neurons increases food intake and body weight in mice.
intervention: Targeted inhibition of IRX3-positive posterior-hypothalamic neurons.
alternative_explanations: Body-weight change may include effects beyond feeding behavior.
falsification_test: Replicate targeted neuronal inhibition without the predicted increase in feeding/body weight, while confirming effective inhibition of the same neuronal population.
